channel.title: Belgian Model 31 Adrian helmet re-used by Gendarmerie - Commentaires
channel.description:
These pictures show a Belgian M31 Adrian helmet. Re-used by the Gendarmerie.
It's a known fact that many army M31 helmets were painted black for use by the Belgian Gendarmerie.
I noticed that this helm was painted black manually and I was curious to find out if it was a former army helmet.
In order to figure this out I removed the lionhead and to my surprise I found an emblem painted underneath de lionhead. On the world war helmets forum Found the origine of the insigna, see:
http://www.world-war-helmets.com/forum/index.php?showtopic=853&hl=gardes+wallonnes
